auto.features.tutorial.lib.steps.literal: Start from a CSV, JSON, or Excel file, or reuse a saved dataset. Choose one or more text columns, select manual, co-pilot, or autopilot labelling, and describe the task when needed. Sessions are saved, can be shared with viewers or editors, and finished labels can move directly into the dataset library.
auto.features.tutorial.lib.steps.templat: {p1} produces answers and {p2} analyses errors and proposes improvements. Configure each role independently, including model, reasoning effort, temperature, and maximum output tokens.

At the top there is navigation to the dashboard, text labelling, submitting a new {p1}, and semantic search across existing runs. At the bottom, the run history appears grouped by date. Through the ⋯ next to a {p2} you can share, rename, clone, pin, or delete.
Each example from the {p1} is shown with a colour-coded {p2} (green = high, red = low), the {p3} prediction, and the split into {p4}, {p5}, and {p6}. You can sort by {p7} to spot patterns.
